title: [Lean] Add checked binary count dispatcher
body:
## Completed chunk and coverage
Adds a concrete seven-state, two-tape, three-symbol binary count dispatcher. For every finite input word and supplied fixed-width counter, it reaches the specified halted endpoint with value (initial value + input length) modulo 2^width. Empty input, zero width and overflow are covered. The checked transition bound is CarryTape.pass's read receipt plus 2 * input length + 1.

Finite coverage: explicit transition tables, marked blank endpoints and supplied-width modular counting. This is not a replay of the complete selected source program.
Conditional-interface coverage: exact CurrentMain.FixedTapeMachine controller and carry-pass interface, including successful-prefix simulation and actual-symbol restart.
Full-theorem coverage: no full multiplication theorem, kappa theorem, width allocation, compact output, cross-model linear amortized bound, source prelude/caller or Plan/Budget composition.

## Author-checked kappa and exact pins
Base: 12a4934d15006e8c10f9b2264f13f8f341be802b.
Head: 79f7c03c7f820ab89955b75ef239cbaccc627e6e.
Explicit author-checked selected conditional project kappa = 90446448750933/125000000000000000 = 0.000723571590007464. The captured selected-result and linked certificate agree. This is source-matched project context, not a kappa bound proved by this helper; all-size compiler, weighted/common-ancestor chart, restored-row, selector/routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-symbolic and analytic-transfer assumptions remain.

## Reuse and attribution
Compared with merged #64: its richer literal counter/stack, directional, exterior-tape, first-completion and amortized results are acknowledged. Binary increment is not claimed as new. This chunk adds the explicit symbol-driven restart controller and its two-tape endpoint in our current machine model. PR64-to-current-model arithmetic transport remains open.
Two exact foundation sources are reused from #488 at edd3102b415df5b9d6f633ac0a4dedcf69c58525; that PR need not be merged. Four source files are included here. Apache-2.0, source attribution and OpenAI-assistance disclosure are preserved.

## Validation and reproduction
Offline Linux/Python3/Lean4.21 checker, no Mathlib or downloads. See research/lean-binary-count-dispatcher/README.md and FOUNDATIONS.json for the separate exact foundation checkout and fresh build-directory command.
Fresh isolated six-module replay: 8.8320 compiler seconds, 0.00303 queue seconds, peak virtual memory 2,735,955,968 bytes. All six object hashes and 36 axiom outputs match accepted evidence. Source/hash manifests, author check, complete scope and replay receipts are included. These local kernel results are separate from fork CI and upstream CI/maintainer gates, which are not claimed passed here.
One additive commit, 17 files, no inherited root changes.
